narrative.intro: National Government Services has federal contract obligations of $62.6M in FY2027 to date. National Government Services received 6 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $10.4M. National Government Services obligations are down 77.8% year over year. Historical totals show National Government Services obligated $254M in FY22, $285M in FY23, $186M in FY24, $261M in FY25, and $282M in FY26. National Government Services’ current FY2027 total is partial and covers the fiscal year to date. National Government Services’ top NAICS market for FY2027 to date is Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers with $62.6M in obligations. National Government Services has $0 in obligations in Computer Systems Design Services for FY2027 to date. The figures for awards listed in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations.
